subject: english
question: **When there is a storm, an eagle _____**_

options.text: uses it to fly away to safety
gets scared and hides to save itself
flies high above it, using its force
waits for it to end, then starts flying

solution:
The correct answer is: **flies high above it, using its force**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The third, fourth and fifth sentence of the second paragraph in the given passage states that- *"When the storm sets in, the eagle spreads its wings and uses the draft of the wind to rise higher and higher in the sky__. It does not run away from the storm, rather __it uses the storm to its advantage__.**"*
 
• That means "**When a storm approaches, the eagle opens its wings and soars upward as a result of the wind's current. It does not flee from the storm; instead, it makes the most of it.**"

From here we can conclude that option 3 is the right answer.
